counts.externalElementsNote: 36 external physical space boundaries exist and none resolved: swept curve is not a readable polyline. The classifier reads IfcSurfaceOfLinearExtrusion (Revit); this file's boundaries are another surface type. Envelope areas here come from the wall walk, not from boundaries, so nothing published depends on this.

areas.openingsNote: Glazing aperture 23.6 m² = 11 IfcWindow at OverallWidth × OverallHeight (23.6 m²). Exterior doors are separate — a door is aperture, not glazing: 2 IfcDoor, 6.8 m², OverallWidth × OverallHeight. Host wall by IfcRelFillsElement → IfcOpeningElement → IfcRelVoidsElement (13 openings). Sector is the host wall's, from the same orientation pass as the wall split. Envelope by a both-sides probe against the conditioned IfcSpace solids (7 of 7 have geometry); this file has no IfcCurtainWall; 3 openings hosted in walls outside the exterior set; nothing unresolved. IsExternal is reported per row and never used as a filter — it means "not an interior partition" to an authoring tool, never "bounds conditioned space against outdoor air". It marks 0 door(s) here; 0 confirm against an exterior wall. Rows in openings.json.
areas.volumeNote: Gross from 7 spaces (floor area × storey height; voids, and rooms taller than their storey with no void above, as their own solids); net from 7 spaces (7 from stated volume quantity). A closed tessellation's signed volume is exact.
areas.roofNote: Plan shadow per element (union of its projected triangles, ifc-plan-shadow.mjs): 2 elements — 2 IfcSlab.PredefinedType=ROOF. roofProjectedSqm sums 2 roof type(s), each as the union of its elements; the elements themselves sum to 143 m² (elements of one type overlapping in plan) and all types together cover 143 m² (one type above another). surfaceSqm is each element's true one-sheet surface (Σ area of its upward faces; ÷ 2 where a surface model has no downward face and both sheets are wound upward; ÷ the coverage where its parts cover its shadow more than once, as stacked layer solids do — surfaceBasis says which), summing to 171.13 m²; a flat deck's surface equals its shadow, a pitched roof's exceeds it. Dach-1 and Dach-2 are IfcSlab typed PredefinedType=ROOF directly, so classifyRoofs matches them with no nameMatch list. Slab-033 (PredefinedType=FLOOR, the 2.7 m mezzanine floor under the Galerie) is correctly excluded as an interior floor, not envelope.
areas.groundNote: IfcSlab (not ROOF or LANDING) on storeys at or below Erdgeschoss (0 m): 1 candidate(s). A slab counts as ground envelope when a conditioned space stands on it — its shadow overlaps a conditioned ground-storey space footprint (6 of 6 such spaces have one: 6 solid) or an IfcRelSpaceBoundary names it as bounding one. IsExternal is not consulted. 1 counted, 0 excluded. groundSlabSqm is the union of the counted shadows (they sum to 120 m²; stacked build-up layers count once); groundPerimeterM is the outline's outer ring.

orientation.note: Azimuths are clockwise from north, where north is the model's -Z after web-ifc's Z-up to Y-up conversion. Outward face inferred by comparing each face's centroid with the building centre, which is correct for a convex plan and can be wrong at a re-entrant corner.
